INFO.SUBTITLE:
is a workshop for research 
and theatrical experimentation in nature.
Born in 2021 from the desire to cultivate a living relationship 
with nature, especially with the vegetal world.
INFO.SECTION_1:
is about living poetically in nature and in places.
It honours the land and takes inspiration from the vegetal world
to explore new human and social perspectives.
INFO.SECTION_2:
is a meeting of identities:
plant, animal, artificial.
It is listening and connecting with the spirit and history of the place.
INFO.SECTION_3:
seeks to mend the painful fracture
between the Artificial and the Natural.
Through symbolic language, it invites a return to original wholeness
and brings unity and fullness.
INFO.SECTION_4:
is a play on words,
or rather, on letters—a kind of anagram.
ART exists both in nature and in theatre: it must be sought.
INFO.SECTION_5:
unfolds through single encounters
or as a laboratory culminating in a performance.

BIO.SUBTITLE: Actress and playwright, she leads theatre workshops for children and adults.
BIO.SECTION_1: Creator and leader of the project ART nATuRe theATRe, a workshop for research and theatrical experimentation in nature inspired by the philosophy of Prof. Stefano Mancuso and the language of gentleness, with performances staged in the woods. Always engaged in promoting social inclusion, gender equality, and civic commitment, she collaborates with organizations and associations on educational projects and intercultural topics. She has conducted a storytelling workshop aimed at asylum seekers, immigrants, and Italians to create opportunities for knowledge exchange between different cultures and knowledges.
BIO.SECTION_2_LIST_ITEM_1: Monologue about the relationship between a mother and her teenage daughter
BIO.SECTION_2_LIST_ITEM_2: A performance about '68 and the development of collective and individual awareness, with dramaturgical coordination by Donatella Diamanti
BIO.SECTION_2_LIST_ITEM_3: About the life of Edith Piaf, for the Ex-it danza company in Livorno
BIO.SECTION_2_LIST_ITEM_4: Performance of the Paese Novo district in Pomarance, at the 47th edition of the Palio di Pomarance
BIO.SECTION_3: She publishes short texts online under the name Mrstulips, which are part of a larger project of writing, images, and goldsmith creations in collaboration with Pepe Factory.
